First, I need to assess the pain severity on a scale from 0 to 10. Rationale: The pain is moderate (5/10), manageable with non-opioid analgesics given the nature of the surgery and absence of severe symptoms. That makes sense because laparoscopic surgeries generally have less pain compared to open surgeries, and non-opioids are first-line here.
